transactional_writes: jobs.state=RUNNING; lease row (owner/expires); attempt row; append JOB_CLAIMED
idempotency: duplicate claim by another worker=fail(one owner)

preconditions: lease valid and owned by caller
transactional_writes: lease.heartbeat_at/expires_at extended; no state change; append LEASE_HEARTBEAT(optional)
side_effects_forbidden: state change or business result change

transactional_writes: jobs.stage updated (descriptive only); no event required(optional STAGE_CHANGED)

preconditions: ready_object_id registered; required verification evidence exists
transactional_writes: jobs.state=READY; ready_object_id set; lease released; append JOB_READY
jobs.state=RETRY_WAIT; failure_code; attempt outcome=failed; append JOB_FAILED_TRANSIENT

terminal_protection: terminal protection bypass only via policy
